```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| results: asis

specs_cols <- c("kmeans_style", "material", "fork", "handlebar", "stack", "reach", "head_tube_angle", "seat_tube_angle","chainstay_length", "front_center", "bottom_bracket_drop", "trail", "trail_45", "udh", "seatpost_diameter", "tire_width_max_700c", "tire_width_max_650b", "fork_class", "axle_spacing", "dropout", "internal_storage", "fork_suspension", "stem_suspension", "rear_suspension", "base_build_usd", "frameset_usd")
keep_cols <- c("model_size", specs_cols)
specs_wide <- geobike[, .SD, .SDcols = keep_cols]
setnames(specs_wide, 
         old = c("model_size", "kmeans_style", "fork_class"),
         new = c("model", "style", "suspension_correction"))
specs_wide[, front_center := round(front_center, 0)]
specs_wide[, trail := round(trail, 0)]
specs_wide[, trail_45 := round(trail_45, 0)]
specs_wide[, frameset_usd := ifelse(is.na(frameset_usd), frameset_usd, paste0("$", frameset_usd))]
specs_wide[, base_build_usd := ifelse(is.na(base_build_usd), base_build_usd, paste0("$", base_build_usd))]

# specs_wide[!is.na(frameset_usd), frameset_usd := paste0("$", frameset_usd)]
# specs_wide[!is.na(base_build_usd), base_build_usd := paste0("$", base_build_usd)]

specs_cols[1] <- "style"
specs_cols[which(specs_cols == "fork_class")] <- "suspension_correction"

dt <- melt(specs_wide,
              id.vars = "model",
              measure.vars = specs_cols,
              variable.name = "spec",
              value.name = "value")

# Pretty spec names
dt[, spec_pretty := str_replace_all(spec, "_", " ")]
dt[, spec_pretty := str_to_title(spec_pretty)]

# how many visible comparison columns
ncols <- 3

# models and defaults for the visible columns
models <- unique(dt$model)
defaults <- models[seq_len(ncols)]

# JSON data for client-side lookup (long format)
json_data <- jsonlite::toJSON(dt, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)

# Build a searchable select for header; use proper 'selected' attribute
header_select <- function(i) {
  opts <- lapply(models, function(m) {
    if (i <= length(defaults) && identical(m, defaults[i])) {
      tags$option(value = m, selected = "selected", m)
    } else {
      tags$option(value = m, m)
    }
  })
  tags$select(
    class = "form-select form-select-sm searchable",
    style = "width:220px; margin:auto;",
    onchange = sprintf("swapColumn(this, %d)", i),
    `data-col-index` = i,
    opts
  )
}

# Build visible table: pretty spec shown, raw spec stored in data-spec attr
tbl <- tags$table(
  class = "table table-striped table-hover align-middle",
  style = "width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;",
  tags$thead(
    tags$tr(
      tags$th("Spec", style="position: sticky; top: 0; background:#f8f9fa; z-index: 2;"),
      lapply(seq_len(ncols), function(i) tags$th(header_select(i), style="position: sticky; top: 0; background:#f8f9fa; z-index: 2;"))
    )
  ),
  tags$tbody(
    lapply(unique(dt$spec), function(s) {
      pretty_name <- dt[spec==s, spec_pretty][1]
      tags$tr(
        # display pretty name, store raw spec in data-spec on this cell for robust JS lookup
        tags$td(pretty_name, `data-spec` = s),
        lapply(seq_len(ncols), function(c) {
          default_model <- if (c <= length(defaults)) defaults[c] else defaults[1]
          val <- dt[spec==s & model==default_model, value]
          if (is.na(val) || identical(val, "NA")) val <- ""
          tags$td(
            `data-spec`  = s,
            `data-col`   = c,
            `data-model` = default_model,
            val
          )
        })
      )
    })
  )
)

# JS: JSON lookup + swap function (makes NA/null blank)
js_lookup <- tags$script(HTML(sprintf("
var specsData = %s;
function swapColumn(selectElem, colIndex) {
  var model = selectElem.value;
  var table = selectElem.closest('table');
  var rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    var spec = row.querySelector('td[data-spec]').getAttribute('data-spec');
    var item = specsData.find(function(d){ return d.spec===spec && d.model===model; });
    if(item){
      var cell = row.querySelector('td[data-col=\"' + colIndex + '\"]');
      if(cell){
        cell.textContent = (item.value === null || item.value === 'NA') ? '' : item.value;
        cell.setAttribute('data-model', model);
      }
    } else {
      // if missing in JSON, clear cell
      var cell = row.querySelector('td[data-col=\"' + colIndex + '\"]');
      if(cell) cell.textContent = '';
    }
  });
}
", json_data)))

# Choices.js assets (no jQuery required)
choices_assets <- tagList(
  tags$link(rel="stylesheet", href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/choices.js/public/assets/styles/choices.min.css"),
  tags$script(src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/choices.js/public/assets/scripts/choices.min.js"),
  # initialize Choices on all .searchable selects and wire change -> swapColumn
  tags$script(HTML("
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var selects = document.querySelectorAll('select.searchable');
  selects.forEach(function(sel) {
    var colIndex = parseInt(sel.getAttribute('data-col-index'), 10);
    // Initialize Choices on the native select element
    new Choices(sel, {
      searchEnabled: true,
      shouldSort: true,
      itemSelectText: '',
      placeholderValue: 'Select model...'
    });
    // Ensure change events trigger the existing onchange handler (swapColumn)
    sel.addEventListener('change', function() {
      // call swapColumn with select element and its column index
      swapColumn(sel, colIndex);
    });
  });
});
"))
)

# --- CSS including sticky header ---
css <- tags$style(HTML("
.table-striped tbody tr:nth-of-type(odd) {background-color: #f9f9f9;}
.table-hover tbody tr:hover {background-color: #e0f7fa;}
th {text-align: center;}
select.form-select {text-align: center;}

/* Sticky header row */
thead th {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: #f8f9fa;
  z-index: 3;
}
"))

cat(as.character(tagList(css, choices_assets, tbl, js_lookup)))

```
